title: Fixed-model core for normalized reindexing substitution
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible, and normalized reindexing data D and T satisfying their Laws. There exists a CompletedOperations.Models C on the two Bool locations, integral completed tensor identifications qY and qX whose composites with tensorRealization and the canonical closed-tensor/left-adjoint codomain comparison equal the fixed full strict-tower realization, the specified calculus, completion, Roos and pullback equalities, the primitive D.limit equation, and ComparisonLaws, SubstitutionLaw and StructuralLaw for C. The tensor Model and Canonical fields are omitted because they are supplied by T.Laws.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5, construction of the fixed normalized operation model before the final packaging.

proof.text: On the two Bool locations use exactly D.completionSource/Target, D.sourceRoos/targetRoos and podReindexCalculus. Use D.CompletionUnits for the unit field. At the selected true-to-false arrow g use D.pullback with D.PullbackNormalization. At every other arrow use the primitive normalized quotient pullback realization. Choose the existing normalized sequence-site duality model at each location.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; canonical tensor presentations and automorphism transport; Stacks 07A4, 08J9, 0941.

proof.text: Compare the tensor realization codomain to the fixed pullbackTensorReferenceTensor by the evaluation-preserving closed-tensor comparison and uniqueness of the reduction left adjoint. Define qY and qX by composing pullbackTensorIntegralTensorModel with the inverses of this codomain comparison and tensorRealization. The two tensor equations are cancellation of these inverses.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; canonical tensor presentations and automorphism transport; Stacks 07A4, 08J9, 0941.

proof.text: The primitive limit equation holds for every system. Expand podOrdinaryToCompleted and pullbackComparison at g. Cancel D.pullback.inv followed by D.pullback.hom. Naturality of D.limit at the source counit moves that counit to the ordinary-pullback side; functoriality and the right triangle identity cancel the source unit against its total-limit counit. No normalized-input hypothesis, D.Counit, or tensor law is needed for this equation.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; canonical tensor presentations and automorphism transport; Stacks 07A4, 08J9, 0941.

proof.text: Apply the proved modelCounit, modelUnit, modelTensor and modelPullback proofs from normalizedCompletedOperationModels to the constructed model, giving PrimitiveLaws. Apply comparisonLaws_of_primitive to these laws, comparison_substitution to every outer expression, and structuralLaw_of_invertible to hcomparison.invertible. Thus all three laws concern this exact model, not an independently chosen existential witness.

statement_change.what: Replace heterogeneous equality between independently chosen tensor codomains by equality after the explicitly constructed canonical codomain isomorphism. Adjunction uniqueness supplies this isomorphism, not equality of the chosen tensor functors. The fixed calculus, completion, Roos and g-pullback pins, the primitive D.limit equation and all expression laws are preserved. This is an interface repair; no assertion is made that the previous stricter HEq condition was proved.

citers.note: Uses the same fixed-D model and strict-tower tensor normalization, now expressed after its canonical codomain comparison. The corresponding Lean consumer compiles with the repaired predicate; no hypothesis or mathematical conclusion of this citer is removed.

old_proof.text: Construct C from the fixed quotient and Roos calculi of D, transport the canonical closed tensor presentations, use D.pullback and its normalization, and prove the primitive limit equation from the counit and triangle identities. The recursive comparison, substitution and structural laws follow by induction on completed expressions and conjugation by invertible comparisons.
